title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are:**

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer who combines deep hands-on delivery skills with organization-wide technical leadership. This role sits at the intersection of feature delivery, platform ownership, and AI-led transformation.

You will own and deliver critical product features end-to-end while simultaneously shaping the architecture, modernization strategy, and AI adoption roadmap across the platform. This role requires a strong builder mindset—someone who can design systems, write production-grade code, unblock teams, and also influence long-term technical direction.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience working with enterprise-grade platforms built on AngularJS/Angular, C#/.NET, SQL Server, Entity Framework, and API-driven systems, and has demonstrated success modernizing such systems into scalable, event-driven, and AI-enabled architectures.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI & Innovation Leadership**

* Drive adoption of AI-first engineering practices across development workflows and product capabilities
* Apply LLMs, Copilot, RAG architectures, and intelligent automation to accelerate feature delivery, testing, and code modernization
* Identify practical opportunities to embed AI into core platform capabilities and business workflows
* Establish guardrails and best practices for scalable, secure, and production-ready AI integration

**2. Architecture & Platform Ownership**

* Define architecture for new features while ensuring alignment with long-term platform evolution
* Evolve the system toward API-first, event-driven, and modular architectures
* Design and enhance platform capabilities built on:
* Web APIs, WebHooks
* Background processing (WebJobs, Windows Services, workers)
* Integration and data exchange layers
* Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term scalability and maintainability

**3. Feature Delivery & Hands-on Engineering**

* Own and deliver complex, high-impact features end-to-end, from design to production rollout
* Write high-quality, maintainable code across backend and frontend layers where needed
* Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to convert requirements into scalable solutions
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across services, APIs, and data layers
* Lead by example through hands-on contributions in critical paths

**4. Modernization & Engineering Excellence**

* Drive modernization of enterprise applications built on the .NET + AngularJS platform
* Refactor legacy patterns into clean, modular, testable components
* Improve system reliability through better logging, monitoring, diagnostics, and observability
* Introduce engineering best practices across:
* Code quality and reviews
* Testing strategies
* Performance optimization
* Production readiness

**5. Organizational Influence & Mentorship**

* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads on system design, coding practices, and architecture
* Influence technical decisions across multiple teams without direct authority
* Establish reusable patterns, frameworks, and engineering standards
* Act as a technical bridge between feature teams, platform teams, and leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant hands-on development and architecture responsibilities
* Proven experience delivering complex enterprise features at scale, while contributing to system design and evolution
* Strong background in designing, building, and modernizing enterprise platforms
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a Principal Engineer / Lead Architect-level contributor
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled development practices (e.g., Copilot, LLM integrations, automation)
* Strong problem-solving skills with ability to debug and optimize across full-stack systems
* Excellent communication and leadership skills with ability to influence across teams

**Core Technology Foundation**

We are looking for a candidate with strong hands-on experience building and evolving enterprise platforms using the following technologies, and a track record of modernizing them toward scalable, API-driven, and AI-enabled systems:

**Frontend Engineering**  
Experience with AngularJS and/or modern Angular, including evolving legacy UI architectures into modular, maintainable systems

**Backend Engineering**  
Deep expertise in C#/.NET, including ASP.NET MVC and Web APIs, building scalable and maintainable backend services

**Data Layer**  
Strong experience with SQL Server and Entity Framework, including schema design, query optimization, and transactional systems

**Background Processing**  
Experience with Windows Services, WebJobs, and asynchronous processing patterns supporting enterprise workloads

**Integration & APIs**  
Strong experience designing and building Web APIs, WebHooks, and event-driven systems

**Observability & Reliability**  
Experience implementing logging, monitoring, and diagnostics frameworks such as ELMAH or equivalent

**AI/ML & Future-Ready Expectations**

* Experience applying AI/ML techniques in software engineering or product development
* Familiarity with:
* LLMs and prompt-driven systems
* RAG architectures and knowledge retrieval systems
* AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, code assistants)
* Ability to translate AI capabilities into practical engineering solutions and measurable impact
* Strong interest in continuously evolving engineering practices using AI as a force multiplier

**Optional / Preferred Technology Exposure**

* Experience with Java (Spring Boot) and related ecosystems for building microservices *(preferred but not mandatory)*
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cloud-native architectures
* Familiarity with microservices, containerization, and DevOps practices
* Experience working with distributed systems and integration-heavy architectures

**Leadership & Influence Expectations**

* Operates effectively across both hands-on delivery and strategic decision-making
* Thinks in terms of systems, scalability, and long-term architecture
* Drives alignment across teams and elevates engineering standards
* Balances speed of delivery with engineering quality and platform health
* Acts as a trusted technical advisor to engineering and product leadership

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently delivers high-impact features with strong design and code quality
* Drives measurable improvements in developer productivity using AI tools
* Successfully modernizes key parts of the platform into API-first, modular systems
* Improves system reliability through better observability and engineering practices
* Establishes reusable technical patterns adopted across teams
* Becomes a go-to expert for solving complex cross-system technical challenges
* Elevates the technical maturity of teams through mentorship and leadership

**Preferred / Distinguishing Factors**

* Experience modernizing legacy enterprise platforms into modern architectures
* Strong product mindset with ability to connect engineering work to business impact
* Track record of influencing architecture across multiple teams
* Contributions to engineering excellence, platform thinking, or AI adoption initiatives

description:

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. 2. Full-Stack Capabilities: Hands-on exposure to front-end development, particularly React and TypeScript, for operational UI integrations.

3. Systems Engineering: Experience with performance tuning, reliability engineering, and building resilient cloud architectures.

4. Security & Design: A security-first mindset when building multi-tenant systems, coupled with strong cross-domain knowledge and design-thinking principles.

title: Senior Dot Net Developer
description:
**Senior .NET Developer – Digi Rythu Bazaar**

**About the role**

We are hiring a **Senior .NET Developer with 6-10 years** of experience to own backend development for Digi Rythu Bazaar, a government-sector digital marketplace that connects farmers directly with consumers. The platform runs live Android and iOS apps backed by .NET APIs.

The next phase includes B2B bulk ordering for wholesale buyers, a catalogue for organic and natural farming products, and a move toward microservices on **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**. You will design, build and scale these services alongside the mobile and web teams. We are looking for resources to **work from office all 5 days a week under full-time employment.**

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain **RESTful APIs in ASP.NET Core** that serve the Digi Rythu Bazaar Android and iOS apps.
* Lead decomposition of the existing backend into microservices and deploy them on AKS with Docker and Helm.
* Build the applications on modular framework in Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture.
* Extend the database schema for sub-variants farming products, including certification, traceability and product attributes.
* Write efficient SQL, stored procedures and EF Core models; tune queries for high-traffic marketplace workloads.
* Integrate payment gateways, SMS/OTP, notification services and government systems (e.g. Aadhaar-based or departmental APIs) securely.
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Apply security, audit-logging and data-protection standards expected of government-sector applications.
* Review code, mentor junior developers and set coding standards for the team.
* Work with product owners, mobile developers and department stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs.

**Required skills and experience**

* **6+ years** of professional development in **C# and .NET,** including **at least 3 years on .NET 6 or later (.NET 8/10 preferred)**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, Dapper, LINQ, Lambda** and dependency injection.
* **Solid SQL Server skills:** schema design, indexing, stored procedures and performance tuning.
* **Exposure to .NET MAUI or Xamarin, or to supporting Android and iOS release cycles.**
* Proven experience building and running **microservices with Docker and Kubernetes,** ideally AKS.
* Working knowledge of Azure services such as **App Service, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Blob Storage and Application Insights.**
* Experience with authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect and role-based access.
* Experience designing APIs consumed by mobile apps: versioning, pagination, caching and offline-friendly responses.
* Familiarity with messaging and caching (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Redis).
* Unit and integration testing with xUnit or NUnit and mocking frameworks.
* Git, code reviews and CI/CD in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with non-technical government stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* **Prior work on government, agriculture, e-commerce or marketplace platforms.**
* Experience migrating legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET.
* Front-end experience with Blazor for reports and back-office portals.
* **Knowledge of API gateways (Azure API Management, YARP), Helm and infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform).**
* **Familiarity with Telugu-language or multilingual content handling.**
* Awareness of CERT-In guidelines, security audits and OWASP Top 10.

**Qualifications and how to apply**

* **B.Tech. / B.E. in Computer Science,** IT, Electronics or a related field, or MCA.
* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) are a plus.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Builder Developer III
description:
**The Builder-3 Profile**

You are a systems engineer for non-deterministic systems. You are comfortable saying "no, not yet" to a working demo, and you can say exactly what would change your mind.

**1. Core DNA (shared foundation, at lead altitude)**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You don't just use AI tools fast — you set the squad's bar for what "fast and safe" looks like, and you remove the bottleneck when someone hits one.
* **Agentic Architecture.** You still build end-to-end agents yourself, and you do. But your leverage comes from designing the state management, tool interfaces and failure semantics that everyone else builds inside.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Sequencing.** You decide *which* legacy modules get modernized first, based on blast radius, data gravity and how cheaply success can be measured — not on which one looks most fun.
* **Measured Reliability.** You define what "reliable enough" means for each workflow: acceptance thresholds, regression suites, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, rollback paths. You know that "100% accurate" is a marketing phrase, and that the engineering version is a measured error rate with a defined containment strategy.

**2. The Three Things You Own**

**a) The Guardrail Layer** Input and output validation, tool-permission scoping, financial and PII data handling, sandboxed execution, human approval gates on irreversible actions, kill switches, blast-radius containment. You assume the agent will eventually do the wrong thing, and you design so that it costs us a log line instead of a General Ledger.

**b) The Eval Framework** Golden datasets built from real ERP edge cases. Offline evals in CI as a merge gate, online evals in production. LLM-as-judge calibrated against human labels — and you know when that calibration has drifted. Regression detection when a model version, prompt or retrieval index changes underneath you. You move the squad from "prompt vibes" to a number that can fail a build.

**c) The Cost & Performance Envelope** Model routing, caching, context budgeting, latency budgets. You track token cost per *completed business transaction*, not per call, and you can tell the CFO why a workflow costs what it costs and where the next 40% comes from.

**3. Elective Depth (be deep in one, fluent in all six)**

* **Agentic Architect (Systems)** — state management and tool-calling interfaces for long-running business processes across complex ERP schemas.
* **UX/Interaction (Product)** — generative UIs and browser-use agents; designing where the human stays in the loop and where they don't need to be.
* **Data & Context (Data)** — RAG and knowledge-graph architecture: vector stores, chunking strategy, retrieval evals, and the relationship between a Purchase Order and a GL entry.
* **Reliability & Eval (QA)** — programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), red-teaming agents, adversarial testing of financial logic.
* **Infra & Agent-Ops (DevOps)** — the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the "thoughts" of the AI; deployment and rollback of prompts and models as versioned artifacts.
* **Domain Logic Translation (Business)** — turning 50 pages of accounting regulation into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You'll Actually Do**

* **Set the definition of shippable.** Write the standard for when an agent can touch production data, and enforce it in code, not in a wiki page.
* **Build the eval harness** and wire it into CI as a gate that can and does block merges.
* **Design the guardrails** around regulated and financial logic, including the human approval and rollback paths.
* **Run design reviews.** Kill bad agent architectures in week one instead of month four. Be specific about why.
* **Own agent incidents.** Pull the traces, find the root cause, and add the eval that makes that failure impossible to reintroduce.
* **Make build-vs-buy calls** on frameworks, vendors and models — and revisit them when the ground shifts, which it will.
* **Grow Builder 1s and 2s** through code review, design review and pairing. Not through ceremony.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Targets to be agreed with the hiring manager — these are illustrative, not fixed.)*

* **90 days:** Eval harness running in CI on at least two live agentic workflows, with a published reliability baseline. A written, enforced guardrail standard.
* **6 months:** Every production agent has a regression suite, a cost-per-transaction number, and a rollback path. Agent-related incidents are down and post-incident evals exist for each.
* **12 months:** The squad ships agentic modules on a predictable cadence without you in the critical path of each one.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry — plus the orchestration layer you'll live in: eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), policy and guardrail tooling, model routing and caching. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You've been burned.** You have shipped an agentic system to real users, watched it fail in a way you didn't predict, and changed your architecture because of it. This is the single strongest signal for this level.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love new models and you still ask for the eval numbers first. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** If you do a task twice, you've already started drafting the workflow that kills it.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema is a puzzle, not a threat.
* **A multiplier.** Your best week is one where the squad shipped three things and you wrote one design doc and two brutal, useful reviews.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the hardest problem in software for AI. Automate a General Ledger and you've mastered the game.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don't do tickets. We do missions. You choose the models, frameworks and architectures you believe will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a "Does It Work?" policy. Note that *you* are the person who defines what "works" means.
* **The Builder Tribe.** You will not be the only AI person in the room. You'll lead a squad of people as obsessed with moving 10x faster as you are.

23 Oct 2026

title: Builder Developer II
description:
**Job Description**

**The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile**

You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first.

**1. Core DNA**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
* **Agentic Implementation.** You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Bridge.** You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else’s problem.
* **Evidence Over Confidence.** You don’t ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases — and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn’t one.

**2. What You Own**

**Your agent.** Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down.

**The evidence it works.** Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does — characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs.

**Your blast radius.** You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry.

**3. Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)**

* **The Agentic Architect (Systems)** — you don’t just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes.
* **The UX/Interaction Builder (Product)** — the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done.
* **The Data & Context Engineer (Data)** — master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry.
* **The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA)** — you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic.
* **The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps)** — you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI.
* **The Domain Logic Translator (Business)** — you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Build execution agents.** Move beyond RAG into action — agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix.
* **Automate the untestable.** Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided.
* **Prove parity.** Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches — on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones.
* **Prompt engineering and evals.** Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions.
* **Rapid prototyping.** Turn a “what if” into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months.
* **Fix your own agents in production.** Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Illustrative — real targets agreed with the hiring manager.)*

* **30 days:** Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small.
* **90 days:** Owning a legacy module end to end — parity evidence, tests, deployment — with minimal supervision.
* **6 months:** Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You’re the person people ask about one thing in particular.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You’ve shipped one.** You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work — not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did.
* **The early adopter.** You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you’ve already started drafting the automation.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn’t complexity, it’s a puzzle about to get solved. You aren’t intimidated by spaghetti code — you’re the one who brings the sauce.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don’t do tickets. We do missions. You’ll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a “Does It Work?” policy.
* **The Builder Tribe.** You won’t be the only AI person in the room. You’ll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon - returns, recommerce, and rentals.  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.  
We are looking for software engineers with 3+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.

title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
* Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
* Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

  
A day in the life  
You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries.  
  
About the team  
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Power BI & Power Platform Developer
description:
About Us:

Groundbreaker. Game changer. Pioneer.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Power BI Developer** with **8+ years** of expertise in Power BI, Power Apps, and SQL Server to join our dynamic team. This individual will play a key role in creating and optimizing business intelligence solutions, leading projects, and managing stakeholder relationships. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills and experience in managing teams, with a proven ability to work both as an individual contributor and as a collaborative team player. The candidate should be able to understand business workflow with respect to projects/program management and come up with proposals of continuous improvement by providing intelligent solution to existing issues. The candidate should be able to design the architectural framework for new requirements and should be able to provide algorithm to proceed using Power BI functional expertise.

Responsibilities:

* **Power BI Development**: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models. Utilize advanced Power BI features, including DAX, Power Query, and data transformations to deliver insightful analytics.
* **Power Apps Development**: Design and implement Power Apps solutions to automate business processes and improve operational efficiency, integrating them with backend systems where necessary.
* **Power Automate Development:** Experienced in leveraging Power Automate flows to streamline and automate data processes within Power BI environments. Skilled in creating seamless workflows to automate data refreshes, trigger notifications, and integrate external systems, ensuring real-time data accessibility and enhanced reporting
* **SQL Server Expertise**: Utilize SQL Server for database design, querying, and optimization. Ensure efficient data extraction and transformation for reporting purposes.
* **Team Leadership & Collaboration**: Lead a team of developers, providing guidance, mentorship, and technical expertise. Facilitate collaboration between team members to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality reports and applications.
* **Stakeholder Management**: Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into actionable BI solutions. Regularly update stakeholders on project progress and outcomes.
* **Individual Contributor**: While taking on a leadership role, the candidate will also be expected to work independently, particularly on complex reporting tasks or when tight deadlines arise.
* **Data Integration & ETL**: Integrate data from various sources (including but not limited to SQL Server, cloud-based systems, and third-party APIs) and ensure smooth ETL processes for data accuracy and consistency.
* **Performance Tuning & Optimization**: Ensure that Power BI reports and dashboards are optimized for performance, utilizing best practices for large datasets and complex queries.
* **Documentation & Best Practices**: Create and maintain technical documentation, ensuring adherence to best practices in data governance, report design, and security standards.

  
Qualifications:

* **Power BI**: Strong experience in developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including advanced features like Power Query, DAX, and Power BI Service.
* **Power Apps**: Proficiency in building and managing Power Apps applications to automate workflows and improve user productivity.
* **Power Automate**: Proficient in designing flows that enhance the efficiency of Power BI reports and dashboards by automating data ingestion, data transformation, and alert management, enabling a more responsive and dynamic business intelligence solution.
* **SQL Server**: Expertise in SQL Server database management, including writing complex queries, stored procedures, and optimizing database performance.
* **Team Leadership**: Proven experience in leading and mentoring a development team, ensuring the successful completion of projects while fostering a collaborative and productive environment.
* **Stakeholder Management**: Strong communication skills to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and manage client expectations.
* **Problem-Solving**: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify issues and propose effective solutions in a timely manner.
* **Project Management**: Ability to handle multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and prioritize effectively while working both independently and in a team setting.

**Must have skills**:

* 8+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying Power BI solutions.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI desktop, Power Query, DAX, Power BI Service, and Power BI Report Server.
* Strong experience in working with large datasets and optimizing Power BI reports for performance.
* Expertise in SQL for complex data querying, transformations, and integrations with Power BI.
* Integrate Power BI with other systems and data sources (SQL, SharePoint, Excel, etc.) for seamless data flow.
* Design and develop custom Power Apps to automate business processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Create, manage, and optimize automated workflows using Power Automate to streamline tasks and integrate systems.

**Good to have skills:**

* Familiarity with other Business Intelligence tools, such as Tableau, QlikView, or Looker, for cross-platform integration and versatility in BI environments.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, such as Azure or AWS, and experience deploying and managing BI solutions in cloud-based environments.
* Experience with Power BI Embedded for integrating BI reports into third-party applications or web portals.
* Familiarity with PowerShell scripting for Power BI administration, report deployment, and automation tasks.
* Experience with data warehousing concepts and solutions, including ETL processes and tools like Azure Data Factory or SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
* Knowledge of Data Governance and best practices in data security, privacy, and compliance for BI applications.
* Experience with Agile project management methodologies and working in cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

EEO Statement:

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

title: Tech Developer – D&C Project Controls Program
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Developer – D&C Project Controls Program
  
Position Overview
  
The Project Intake Developer serves as the technical backbone of the Design & Construction (D&C) Project Controls Program's intake platform. This role is responsible for the end-to-end management of the Project Intake product — from maintaining platform stability and resolving customer-reported issues, to designing and delivering feature upgrades that enhance the user experience. The Developer operates at the intersection of software engineering, customer support, and product delivery, ensuring the intake platform remains reliable, performant, and aligned with evolving business needs across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.
  
A core function of this role is translating customer feedback and operational pain points into actionable technical improvements, managing the product backlog, and communicating platform changes clearly and proactively to stakeholders. The Developer is expected to own the full product lifecycle — triaging defects, shipping enhancements, maintaining data integrity, and building trust with customers through transparent, timely communication about what's changing and why.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Customer Complaint Management & Issue Resolution
  
Serve as the technical point of contact for customer-reported issues, bugs, and service disruptions related to the Project Intake platform.
  
Triage, diagnose, and resolve platform defects — performing root-cause analysis and implementing permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
  
Maintain a structured issue-tracking workflow (using SIM, or equivalent ticketing systems) to ensure all customer complaints are logged, prioritized, and resolved within defined SLAs.
  
Analyze complaint trends and recurring issues to identify systemic platform weaknesses and inform the product improvement roadmap.
  
Communicate resolution timelines and status updates to affected customers and stakeholders in a clear, empathetic, and professional manner.
  
  
Feature Upgrades & Product Development
  
Own the product backlog for the Project Intake platform — gathering requirements from customers, intake coordinators, analysts, and leadership to prioritize feature enhancements.
  
Design, develop, test, and deploy new features and functionality that improve intake workflows, data capture accuracy, and user experience.
  
Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms (e.g., Amazon Q, Amazon Quick Suite, internal ML/NLP solutions) to build intelligent automation into the intake product — including smart routing, auto-classification, and predictive triage capabilities.
  
Collaborate with UX/UI stakeholders to ensure feature designs are intuitive, accessible, and aligned with customer needs.
  
Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) with key stakeholders and iterate based on feedback before production release.
  
Develop and maintain APIs and integrations that connect the intake platform with downstream project execution systems, reporting tools, and data warehouses.
  
  
Platform Maintenance & Reliability
  
Ensure the ongoing stability, performance, and security of the Project Intake platform through proactive monitoring, patching, and infrastructure management.
  
Manage platform deployments, version control, and release cycles — maintaining a clean CI/CD pipeline and minimizing downtime during updates.
  
Conduct regular code reviews, technical debt assessments, and performance optimization to maintain platform health and scalability.
  
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation — including system architecture diagrams, runbooks, deployment procedures, and configuration guides.
  
Implement and monitor data validation rules, error handling, and logging to ensure data integrity across the intake pipeline.
  
Establish and maintain disaster recovery procedures and backup protocols for platform data and configurations.
  
  
Change Communication & Customer Engagement
  
Develop and execute a structured change communication plan for all platform updates — including feature releases, bug fixes, scheduled maintenance, and deprecations.
  
Create clear, customer-facing release notes, knowledge base articles, FAQs, and training materials that explain what's changing, why, and how it impacts users.
  
  
Dashboard Development & Data Visualization
  
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (using QuickSight, or similar tools) that provide real-time visibility into intake KPIs — including time-to-assignment, SLA adherence, request completion rates, routing accuracy, and workload distribution across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.
  
Develop self-service reporting solutions that enable stakeholders and leadership to explore intake data independently.
  
Create executive-ready visualizations and narratives that translate complex data into clear, compelling stories for D&C Project Controls leadership.
  
Continuously iterate on dashboard design based on user feedback, evolving business needs, and new data sources.
  
  
Data Analysis, Improvement & Insight Generation
  
Analyze intake data across project types (new construction, renovations, and small-scale projects) to identify volume trends, bottlenecks, cycle-time variances, and resource allocation patterns.
  
Proactively assess data quality and integrity — identifying inconsistencies, gaps, duplicates, and classification errors within intake datasets and recommending corrective actions.
  
Develop and implement data cleansing, standardization, and enrichment processes to improve the reliability and usability of intake data over time.
  
  
AI Tool Utilization & Automation
  
Leverage in-house AI tools and platforms (e.g., Amazon Q, Amazon Quick Suite, internal ML/NLP solutions) to automate request triage, classification, and preliminary routing recommendations.
  
Monitor and validate AI-triage output quality — flagging misclassifications, calibrating confidence thresholds, and providing feedback loops to improve model accuracy over time.
  
Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for document review, scope extraction, and compliance gap identification within intake submissions.
  
  
Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
  
Use data analysis, customer feedback, and AI insights to identify inefficiencies in intake workflows and propose evidence-based improvements.
  
Develop and refine scoring models, routing criteria, and prioritization frameworks grounded in historical performance data.
  
Contribute to the establishment and monitoring of service level agreements (SLAs) and performance benchmarks.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Experience
  
4–6 years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or technical product management within corporate real estate, facilities management, design & construction, or professional services environments.
  
Proven track record of managing customer complaints and translating user feedback into product improvements.
  
Experience designing and building dashboards and performance reports that drive operational decision-making.
  
Proven track record of improving data quality and using data to drive process improvement and operational efficiency.
  
knowledge of Amazon BI tools, e.g. Quick Suite, internal NLP/ML platforms) strongly preferred.
  
  
Skills & Competencies
  
Software Development & Platform Management — Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java) with experience in web application development, API design, and database management (SQL, NoSQL).
  
Customer Issue Management — Experience using ticketing systems (SIM, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent) to triage, track, and resolve customer-reported issues within SLA targets.
  
Dashboard & Visualization Skills — Proven ability to design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Ability to tell a data story through compelling visualizations.
  
AI & Automation Proficiency (Preferred) — Hands-on experience with AI-enabled tools, generative AI platforms, or machine learning applications in a business context. Familiarity with in-house AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Amazon Quick Suite, internal NLP/ML platforms) strongly preferred.
  
  
Personal Attributes
  
Customer-first mindset with a genuine commitment to resolving issues quickly and communicating transparently with stakeholders.
  
Ownership mentality — treats the platform as their product, proactively identifying and fixing problems before they escalate.
  
Adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with an evolving product and technology landscape.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Software Development Manager, GREF Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules — integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments.  
  
You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses.  
  
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and leading teams of software engineers, front-end engineers, and technical program managers, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level systems at scale. They will be a strategic thinker who hires and develops exceptional talent, sets clear goals tied to organizational impact, and independently manages both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities — fostering a high-performance, team-oriented culture.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Software Development Manager, you will:  
  
Technical Leadership & Innovation Shape architectural decisions for next-generation Travel & Expense systems and services that process sensitive financial and employee data across 64 countries Drive adoption of AI technologies — including agentic AI, LLMs, and ML-powered pattern detection — to transform manual travel and expense operations into intelligent, autonomous workflows Design scalable, secure systems with enterprise-grade controls, observability, and auditability built in from day one Build flexible integration patterns that bridge modern and legacy transactional systems across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules Partner with AWS teams to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities and primitives.  
  
Team Leadership Lead a high-performing engineering team building solutions that support Travel & Events operations and transactions at massive scale Hire, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent across backend, frontend, and program management disciplines Set clear goals tied to measurable organizational impact and independently manage both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities Foster a culture of continuous improvement through data-driven insights, rigorous testing, and robust governance frameworks.  
  
Impact Transform how 500,000+ Amazonians plan travel, book events, manage payments, and submit expenses — replacing fragmented, manual processes with a unified AI-powered experience that scales globally Drive measurable operational efficiencies by reducing cycle times, manual touchpoints, and error rates in complex travel and expense workflows Influence the automation and AI strategy for one of Amazon's largest employee-facing platforms.  
  
A day in the life

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Software Engineer – 4+ years
description:

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer (C#, .Net, Advanced SQL - Sports Domain Experience)
description:
### **Description**

**Role Summary**  
The Stats Developer builds, supports, and improves the systems and integrations that power live sports statistics across DAZN/Fox Sports products and broadcast workflows. The role focuses on ingesting, validating, transforming, and publishing sports data from third-party providers and internal capture systems so it can be used reliably by digital products, broadcast graphics, and internal stakeholders.  
This role sits at the intersection of sports data, live operations, product delivery, and stakeholder support — covering provider integrations, internal capture platforms, broadcast data feeds, and operational support for a 24x7 sports data environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Sports Data Integrations**

* Build, maintain, and support integrations with external sports data providers including, but not limited to Sport radar and Champion Data.
* Support real-time and near-real-time ingestion pipelines for sports such as AFL, Netball, NRL, Cricket, Football, Basketball, Motorsport, and others as required
* Map provider data into internal schemas and publishing models used by APIs, widgets, broadcast systems, and internal tools
* Investigate and resolve issues with incoming feeds, data quality, sequencing, match states, and downstream publishing
* Support changes required when providers update feed structures, fields, or delivery patterns

**Internal Stats Capture Support**

* Support and enhance in-house stats capture systems used for sports including NRL and Cricket
* Work closely with the internal stats division to ensure captured data is correctly stored, validated, published, and displayed

  downstream requirements

* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server
* Strong SQL skills including:  
  o query writing  
  o stored procedures  
  o views  
  o triggers  
  o data investigation and troubleshooting  
  o performance-aware database development
* Experience working with .NET / C# applications
* Experience supporting or developing desktop applications used for operational or capture  
  workflows
* Experience working with data integration services, import processes, and real-time or near-realtime data pipelines
* Experience with XML, JSON, and API/data-feed integration patterns
* Experience troubleshooting production issues across application, database, and integration layers
* CI/CD and Github actions

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the Yocto-based build infrastructure and board support software that enable AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGAs. You will own the layers, distributions, and toolchains that turn new AMD silicon into a buildable, supportable software platform for Linux, OpenBMC, and real-time workloads.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, kernel and firmware teams, and the Yocto and OpenEmbedded communities, you will take new silicon from first power-on to a supportable, upstreamable platform, and build the images, SDKs, and reference designs customers develop against.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about embedded Linux and build systems, and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in Yocto and board support package development, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through silicon bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable across the full stack, from a device tree node to a released SDK, and collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Yocto Build Infrastructure:** Design and maintain the Yocto and OpenEmbedded layers that enable new AMD silicon — SoC family definitions, machine configurations, tunes, and layer architecture across BSP and distro layers.
* **Kernel, Bootloader and Boot Image Integration:** Integrate recipes for the Linux kernel, U-Boot, TF-A, and platform firmware, and build the boot artifact pipeline — device tree packaging, flash layout, signing, secure boot, and golden-image recovery.
* **Multi-Domain Builds and SDKs:** Define multiconfig builds that produce Linux, RTOS, firmware, and programmable logic artifacts together, and deliver the SDKs and toolchains teams develop against.
* **Adaptive SoC and Programmable Logic:** Integrate programmable logic into the software stack, including bitstream packaging, device tree overlays, and enabling PL interfaces from Linux.
* **Silicon and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new silicon and board bring-up from first power-on, holding the integrated image and driving issues to root cause with hardware and firmware teams.
* **CI, Release and Technical Leadership:** Maintain QEMU-based virtual platforms and continuous integration, deliver release artifacts and software bills of materials, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Deep hands-on experience with the **Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, and BitBake** — authoring recipes, bbappends, and classes, building BSP and distro layers, SDK generation, and diagnosing complex build failures.
* Strong **embedded Linux** and board support package background: the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint, device trees, kernel configuration and fragments, driver enablement, and bootloaders and early firmware such as **U-Boot and TF-A**.
* Familiarity with **BMC products and the platform management domain**, and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, eSPI, and PECI.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting for build and automation work.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning build systems, operating systems, drivers, bootloaders, and firmware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™ and hardware/software co-design.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, and **RISC-V** or other non-x86 architectures, including board enablement and toolchain integration.
* Inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP** in heterogeneous multi-core systems.
* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack and its integration into a Yocto distribution.
* **QEMU** or comparable virtual platforms for pre-silicon development and continuous integration.
* Experience developing **reference designs or proof-of-concept solutions**, and release engineering at scale including SBOM and CVE triage.
* Contributions to the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, or Linux open-source projects, with strong analytical and communication skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

title: Software Development Engineer, Returns and Recommerce
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.  
  
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.  
  
We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience  
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience  
Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
About Signant Health
  
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Associate Operations Software Engineer creates, enhances, and maintains business applications, configures custom code to support the company’s business needs, and moves those configurations through a standard SDLC progression. The Engineer is accountable for project deliverables in line with quality targets and SLAs, while adhering to best practices, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), company processes, and global industry regulations. The ideal candidate has basic product knowledge and basic knowledge of user applications.
  
  
This is a 6-month contract role with the potential to convert to a full-time position (contract-to-hire).

Quality System Responsibilities

* Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server Reporting Services, and T-SQL
* Microsoft Visual Studio IDE, ASP.NET MVC, and C# with LINQ

* Atlassian Suite tools such as Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira, Xray, and Jira Service Management
* Source control software such as Team Foundation Server, Bitbucket, or other Git-based tools

* Experience with CICSPlex SM, CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and release management.

Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

We’re here to champion your journey. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Automation & AI Agentic Engineer)
description:
Responsibilities:

**What You'll do**

We are seeking an Automation & AI Agentic Engineer to design, build, and support a hybrid automation portfolio that spans traditional RPA and next-generation agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands-on across **Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Studio, Agent Core, Power Automate, and UiPath (including UiPath Agentic Automation/Agentic Orchestration)** evaluate which platform and approach - rule-based bot, low-code flow, or autonomous AI agent - best fits a given business process.

**Automation & AI Agentic Engineer** (Intelligent Automation Developer)

**You'll have opportunity to:**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using **UiPath** and **Microsoft Power Automate**, following CoE development standards and reusable component libraries.
* Build and orchestrate **AI agents** using **Agent Core**, **UiPath Agentic Automation** (agentic orchestration, agent-to-agent/human-in-the-loop workflows), and **Microsoft Copilot Studio** for goal-driven, autonomous or semi-autonomous process automation.
* Use **GitHub Copilot** (chat, inline completion, agent mode) to accelerate development, code review, and testing across automation and supporting application code.
* Assess incoming automation requests and recommend the right-fit solution (deterministic RPA bot vs. low-code Power Platform flow vs. AI agent vs. hybrid) based on process complexity, data variability, and exception handling needs.
* Integrate automations with enterprise systems via APIs, databases, message queues, and connectors; manage credentials/secrets securely (vault integration, least-privilege access).
* Implement AI components where required: document/IDP processing, LLM-based reasoning steps, prompt design, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns for knowledge-grounded agents.
* Apply governance, security, and responsible-AI practices: exception handling, logging/observability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, data privacy, and bias/hallucination mitigation for agentic components.
* Participate in solution design reviews (PDD/SDD), UAT, hypercare, and production support/incident triage for deployed bots and agents.
* Maintain documentation for developed solutions, including agent decision logic, guardrails, and rollback/fallback procedures.
* Collaborate with Solution Leads/Architects on scalability, CI/CD pipeline integration, and CoE standards adoption; mentor junior developers on both RPA and agentic development practices.
* Stay current on platform releases (UiPath, Agent Core, Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot, GitHub Copilot) and recommend adoption of new capabilities.

Qualifications:

**Who You are:**
================

Experience: 4 to 7 total automation experience (RPA + AI agentic), or equivalent demonstrated skill for internal candidates transitioning from a traditional RPA Developer/Sr. Developer role.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s(Engineering)/Master’s in computer science or a related field.

Must Have:

* 3+ years of hands-on RPA development experience with **UiPath** (workflow design, exception handling, reusable components, and orchestrator administration).
* Working experience with **Microsoft Power Automate** (cloud/desktop flows) and familiarity with the broader **Power Platform** (Power Apps, Dataverse, connectors).
* Hands-on exposure to **Agent Core**, **UiPath Agentic Automation**, or comparable agentic/AI-agent orchestration capability (goal-driven agents, agent-to-agent workflows, autonomous decisioning).
* Practical experience using **GitHub Copilot** (or similar AI coding assistant) in day-to-day development.
* Understanding of GenAI/LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, tokens/context windows, RAG concepts, and where AI agents outperform (or underperform) deterministic bots.
* Proficiency with REST APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, and at least one scripting/programming language (Python, VB.NET, or C#).
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for both rule-based and non-deterministic (AI agent) failure modes.
* Excellent communication skills to translate business requirements into automation/agent solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **UiPath Agentic Automation** certification (Associate/Professional) or relevant Agent Core certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) or Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200).
* GitHub Copilot certification or GitHub Agentic AI Developer certification.
* Exposure to cloud AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI).

**Core Competencies**

**Category**

**Skills**

RPA Platform

UiPath

Low-Code / AI Agent Platforms

Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Agent Core, UiPath Agentic Automation

AI-Assisted Development

GitHub Copilot (chat, inline completion, agent mode), Claude Code

AI/GenAI Foundations

Prompt engineering, LLM basics, RAG, agent orchestration

Integration

REST APIs, SQL, queues, connectors

Governance

Exception handling, logging/observability, responsible AI, security best practices

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Curiosity and continuous-learning mindset toward evolving automation/AI tooling.
* Comfort working with both deterministic (RPA) and probabilistic (AI agent) systems.
* Ownership and accountability for solution quality, security, and production stability.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with business, security, and architecture teams.

  
Additional Information:

Our Engineering Culture:

In our Agile/Lean DevOps environment, we've nurtured a culture of innovation and experimentation across our development teams. As a customer-focused organization, we collaborate closely with our end users and product owners to understand and rapidly respond to emerging business needs. Collaboration is ingrained into every aspect of our work – from the products we develop to the world-class service we offer. We are motivated by the belief that diversity of thought, background, and perspective is crucial to crafting the finest products and experiences for our customers. Come join us and become a part of a highly ambitious team dedicated to delivering impeccable solutions!
