As a Software Developer II on the Smart Water pod, you will build the customer-facing Smart Water experience inside the RealPage Smart Building Portal and the services behind it. You will work across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL, integrating meter and usage data from upstream systems.

A core part of the mission is making Smart Water scale: replacing today's manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service workflows, hardening the data-ingestion pipeline, and building water-usage anomaly detection that flags running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, and abnormal consumption for operators.

This role suits a developer with a few years of full-stack experience who wants to own medium-sized features end to end in a small, high-ownership pod and grow into the product's AI roadmap (a Smart Water MCP that powers a Lumina Copilot).

Responsibilities:

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Smart Water features across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL.
* Integrate meter, usage, and occupancy data from upstream systems and improve the reliability of the ingestion pipeline.
* Develop water-usage anomaly detection that surfaces sustained anomalies (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) from interval meter data.
* Replace manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service setup and data-management workflows.
* Surface Smart Water inside the Smart Building Portal (SBP) and contribute to the Smart Water MCP that powers Lumina AI workflows.
* Write clean, well-tested code and partner closely with the pod's QA engineer on quality and data integrity.

Qualifications:

This is a full-stack role on a C#/.NET 8 and Angular codebase backed by MSSQL.

* 2+ years building production software, full-stack or backend-leaning.
* Proficiency in C#/.NET (ASP.NET Web API) and solid SQL / relational data-modeling skills (MSSQL).
* Front-end experience with Angular or a similar modern framework.
* Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs and working with upstream/third-party data sources.
* Comfort writing tested, maintainable code and working in a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Skills but not** **required**

* Experience with data-pipeline / ingestion work and diagnosing data-quality issues.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch.
* Interest in applied AI — building MCP servers or LLM-powered features (e.g., a Lumina Copilot).
* Familiarity with OIDC / single sign-on integration.

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineer II with 3–6 years of professional experience in building, maintaining, and supporting enterprise web applications and services. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with ASP.NET, .NET Framework, .NET 6 or later, C#, SQL Server, and cloud-native application development using Azure App Service and Azure Kubernetes Service.

The individual will be part of an Agile Scrum team and will contribute across the software development lifecycle, including design, development, unit testing, debugging, performance analysis, deployment support, and production issue resolution. C#, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, .NET 6 or later, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, SQL Server, REST APIs, cloud application development, debugging, performance troubleshooting, and secure software development practices.

Angular or other modern web UI frameworks, Docker, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, logging and monitoring tools, distributed application troubleshooting, and basic infrastructure or cloud operations knowledge.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 10 years of experience in software development.
* 3 years of experience with technical leadership.
* 3 years of experience managing teams of software engineers.
* Experience in full-stack development and mobile app development.

**About the job**
-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of software engineers. You will be responsible for career growth, providing coaching, and managing performance to build an engineering organization.

title: Software Engineer IV
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**

  

Do you love building software that thrills your customers using AIDLC? Do you insist on high standards for the systems you and your teams design and build? Are you a progressive, hands-on software engineer with an architect’s mindset, an advocate of agile development practices, and a proponent of continuous improvement? Well if this is you, then join an energetic team of engineers building next generation applications for PDI! Software Engineer 4 is our senior-most engineering level and operates at the scope of a Software Architect. You will own the technical architecture and solution design for your product area as we drive to continuously increase our cloud maturity and mobility, defining how services are structured, integrated, secured, and scaled, and making the key design decisions for new and existing applications. You will lead medium and large sized projects, set technical direction and engineering standards across teams, and guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels. You will partner with Product Management, Software Architects, and DevOps on solution feasibility, estimation, and the technical roadmap, and serve as the evangelist and custodian of our technology, architecture, and product. With the variety of environments, platforms, technologies & languages, you must be comfortable working in both Windows & Linux environments and learning a variety of programming languages.  
  
This is a hands-on architect-level position (~60% hands-on design and coding, ~40% architecture, technical leadership, and mentoring) requiring expert proficiency in .NET Core, React, SQL Server, and cloud-native architecture on Azure, with ownership of system design, architectural decisions, and engineering quality across teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture and solution design for your product area, and be accountable for design decisions for new and existing applications, proactively escalating issues and seeking assistance to overcome obstacles.
* Define and document target-state architecture, system designs, and architecture decision records (ADRs); run design reviews and ensure implementations stay consistent with the agreed architecture.
* Design for non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, and compliance such as PCI DSS) and make the trade-offs between them explicit.
* Define service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns (REST, messaging and event-driven), and data models across services and third-party systems.
* Lead medium and large sized projects end-to-end, from architecture and design through production deployment.
* Set technical direction, coding standards, and engineering best practices across teams; guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels, including through code and design reviews.
* Actively design, develop, and maintain critical services and enterprise applications using .NET Framework, .NET Core, and React, building reference implementations and proofs of concept.
* Partner with Product Management to consult on solution feasibility, high-level effort estimation, and the technical roadmap.
* Prepare and provide project status and risk assessments, including technical and architectural risks, to management with appropriate levels of detail to ensure programs stay on schedule.
* Collaborate with Software Architects and DevOps teams to evaluate tools, processes, technologies, and cloud infrastructure, including build-versus-buy decisions.
* Make recommendations for technology adoption and framework improvement, analyzing trends, patterns, and best practices for software, including AI-assisted development (AIDLC).
* Serve as the evangelist and custodian of technology, architecture, and product.
* Identify systemic performance, reliability, and scalability risks; drive root-cause analysis of production incidents and the architectural fixes that follow.
* Use a disciplined approach in an Agile environment to assist in analysis and determination of preferred solutions to technical challenges.
* Troubleshoot, test, and validate software issues; resolve issues with due urgency and maintain thorough documentation of all software solutions.
* Work with Product Owner to clarify and estimate feature work, and with QA Engineers to develop optimal product test plans and resolve issues found during release stabilization.
* Own the technical debt roadmap: identify, prioritize, and drive modernization and improvements across teams.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field plus 9+ years’ experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications in a software product development environment, OR equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience serving as a technical team lead or in an architecture role.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering distributed, cloud-native systems end-to-end, including microservices, event-driven architecture, and API design.
* Expert in: .NET Framework, .Net/.NET Core, C#, SQL, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, MVC, REST API, React.
* Strong knowledge of architecture and design principles: design patterns, domain-driven design, SOLID, scalability, resiliency patterns, caching, and messaging (for example, Azure Service Bus).
* Strong experience with SQL Server and NoSQL data stores (for example, Cosmos DB): data modeling, stored procedures, and query performance tuning.
* Deep knowledge of C# development including: multi-threading, memory management, async programming, microservices, dependency injection.
* 3+ years of experience designing and running cloud native applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP): Infrastructure as a Service, Docker/containers, CI/CD, and observability.
* Understanding of application security and compliance (OWASP, PCI DSS), with experience in payments or other regulated domains preferred.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (AI-based agents) and the ability to drive their adoption across teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Visual Studio IDE and the use of Azure DevOps or Jira.
* 2+ years of practical experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others and take action.
* Requires strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and present architecture to technical and business audiences.
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks with competing deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to work under pressure.
* Considers ‘best-practice’ standards, as well as departmental policies and procedures.
* Experience working in retail or payments solution is preferred.

### **Behavioral Competencies**

* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. title: Software Engineer, Senior B Performance Engineering
description:
**Senior Software Performance Engineer**

*6+ Years Experience | PAX India*

**About the Role**
==================

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud — building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others.

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too — the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly.

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Load & Synthetic Test Tooling**
---------------------------------

* Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework — test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting.
* Apply AI capabilities to improve test development — AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis.
* Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc.

**Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis**
-----------------------------------------------

* Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation.
* Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/.NET and/or Java services.
* Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics).

**Ongoing**
-----------

* Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating.
* Design and maintain C#/.NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability.
* Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

* 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering.
* Strong C#/.NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience.
* Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments.
* Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
* Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic).
* Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis).
* Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues.
* Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance.
* Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You**
=====================================

* Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction.
* Have systemic curiosity — you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database.
* Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Gatling or Playwright experience specifically.
* AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens.
* Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript.
* Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning).
* Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis.

**Quick Summary**
=================

*“Backend-heavy engineer who codes daily, hunts down and fixes performance bottlenecks, and operates production systems; strong in C#/.NET and/or Java, Azure, compute/resource performance fundamentals, load testing, and observability.”*

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our *Intelligence for Good®* vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Sr. Snowflake Developer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Snowflake Developer / Data Engineer (IC3) to take self-directed ownership of features and small epics within our Snowflake data platform — including Bronze/Silver/Gold data layer architecture, ELT pipelines, and the data models that power analytics and reporting across Keyloop. Beyond hands-on delivery, you will lead design discussions for your own work, coach more junior developers, and work with stakeholders across Finance, Sales, and Operations to deliver reliable, scalable, and well-governed data products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complete delivery of features and small epics on the Snowflake platform, from design through to production, without senior oversight

* Build and maintain ELT pipelines using Boomi, dbt, or SQL-based transformations into Snowflake
* Architect and manage Bronze / Silver / Gold data layers in line with Keyloop's data platform standards
* Develop and optimise complex SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and reporting use cases
* Implement Snowflake performance best practices: clustering keys, result caching, query profiling, and warehouse right-sizing
* Own testing strategy for pipeline and model changes, ensuring comprehensive coverage beyond unit-level checks

* Lead technical design discussions for your features and represent the team in cross-functional planning meetings
* Coordinate cross-functional data requirements with adjacent teams (Finance, Sales, Operations)
* Support data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and lineage documentation
* Manage Snowflake environment configuration across dev, QA, and production
* Contribute to data governance: access control, data masking, row-level security, and tagging
* Monitor pipeline health, proactively identify failures, and provide production support — including occasional out-of-hours incident response
* Support UAT cycles with technical recommendations and sign-off
* Produce clear technical documentation: data dictionaries, ERDs, pipeline runbooks

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–7 years of Snowflake development experience in a production data environment
* Strong SQL skills — window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, and advanced aggregations
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake-specific features: streams, tasks, dynamic tables, time travel, zero-copy cloning
* Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines from source systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, or ERP platforms
* Understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts (star schema, slowly changing dimensions)
* Familiarity with Snowflake access controls: roles, grants, and row/column-level security
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD for data pipeline deployment
* Ability to translate business data requirements into technical data models
* Demonstrated ability to coach or mentor junior developers, and to lead technical discussions within a team

**Desirable Skills**

* SnowPro Core or Advanced Data Engineer certification
* Experience with dbt (data build tool) for transformation orchestration
* Exposure to Boomi as an integration tool feeding Snowflake
* Familiarity with Salesforce data structures and Salesforce reporting requirements
* Experience with NetSuite financial data extraction and modelling
* Knowledge of data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or similar)
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams and Jira-based project management
* Background in automotive, SaaS, or financial systems data

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

Are you ready to architect highly available, large-scale enterprise software platforms that solve complex, ambiguous problems? We're seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join Amazon's Finance Automation Payroll Technology team, where you'll define the technical vision for core product areas and transform how we enable accurate, timely payroll processing across multiple countries at scale.

Design and architect scalable, reliable solutions for complex payroll and financial systems that integrate across multiple services, countries, and regulatory environments

A day in the life  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our Payroll Technology team, you'll focus on designing and building systems that ensure every Amazonian gets paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with global regulations. Your day might include collaborating with engineering and finance stakeholders to decompose complex business challenges into clear technical strategies, leading architecture discussions that span multiple services and teams, and conducting code reviews that elevate the quality bar across the organization. You'll also mentor engineers at various levels, establish practices and tooling that make high quality the team's default, and work across time zones with colleagues globally to plan and deliver the next generation of our payroll platform.  
  
About the team  
We are a dedicated team building first-of-its-kind systems to streamline payroll processing and provide an excellent pay experience for Amazonians worldwide. Our mission is to enable our business to pay every team member accurately, on time, and at scale, with zero defects. As Amazon's workforce grows in size and geography, payroll operations become increasingly complex, and we're solving this through technology rather than process alone. You'll join a collaborative group focused on building systems that track and monitor payroll accuracy and compliance across countries and regions. We're excited to work with someone who can help us shape our multi-year roadmap and establish the engineering practices that will define our team's future.

Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)  
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
### **Description**

We're growing our core engineering team and looking for seasoned Software Engineers to take ownership of building and scaling our platform end to end. You'll design and ship microservices in Java, build clean REST APIs, own front-end features, and increasingly work on agentic AI capabilities that connect large language models to our enterprise systems.  
This is a hands-on full-stack role for someone with strong engineering fundamentals who already builds with modern AI tooling and is curious about where it's headed. We value engineering depth and learning speed over years spent on any single emerging protocol.

title: SDE III, WW Returns and ReCommerce
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.  
  
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.  
  
We are looking for software engineers with 5+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software systems consisting of multiple features, ensuring solutions are scalable, extensible, and secure.
* Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade-offs across scalability, maintainability, performance, and security, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals.
* Collaborate with engineers on related teams to define system interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and create the right checkpoints for successful delivery of multi-engineer projects.
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices across your team, including code quality standards, operational excellence through proper alarms, telemetry, and runbook processes, and effective use of generative artificial intelligence tools to augment productivity.
* Actively mentor and coach other engineers by providing technical guidance on system design, code reviews, and career development, raising the overall capability of your team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team improves the reliability, performance, responsiveness, battery life, memory efficiency, and overall health of Windows devices. We build and operate the services, telemetry systems, and data pipelines that transform signals from labs and the installed base into trustworthy metrics, actionable diagnostics, and measurable engineering improvements.

We are seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to define the technical direction for critical Windows Fundamentals data and service capabilities. You will shape architecture across backend services, telemetry platforms, data pipelines, metrics, and diagnostic workflows; solve the portfolio's most complex technical problems; and influence engineering investments that improve Windows health at scale.

This role is ideal for a deeply technical engineering leader who combines distributed-systems and data-platform expertise with solid product judgment, hands-on problem solving, and the ability to align and inspire engineers across organizational boundaries.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Define the technical strategy and architecture for Windows Fundamentals backend services, telemetry systems, data pipelines, metrics, cohort frameworks, and diagnostic capabilities.
* Lead the design of scalable systems for telemetry ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, health monitoring, analytics, diagnostics, and automated engineering workflows.
* Set technical standards for service reliability, security, compliance, privacy, observability, data quality, schema evolution, deployment safety, incident response, and operational excellence.
* Lead the most complex cross-system investigations involving large-scale telemetry, statistical analysis, systems debugging, service behavior, and Windows product-health signals.
* Create architectural simplifications, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities that detect issues earlier, reduce operational toil, and increase engineering leverage across Windows.
* Use data, customer insights, and business priorities to frame ambiguous problems, evaluate portfolio tradeoffs, manage technical risk, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Serve as a technical authority and hands-on contributor; mentor senior engineers, lead design reviews, build alignment across teams, and influence Windows engineering, data science, security, silicon, OEM, and service partners.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
  + OR equivalent experience.

* Extensive experience architecting and delivering backend services, distributed systems, data pipelines, telemetry platforms, large-scale analytics, or engineering infrastructure.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-team technical initiatives and delivering highly reliable production systems or platforms at scale.
* Deep technical judgment in service architecture, systems design, data engineering, security, reliability, debugging, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Solid programming and hands-on problem-solving skills, with the ability to move between architecture, implementation, investigation, and operational response.
* Ability to set technical strategy, navigate ambiguity, prioritize investments using data, and influence decisions across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
* Deep experience with cloud services, distributed systems, data engineering, telemetry platforms, developer infrastructure, or business-critical production operations.
* Solid knowledge of Windows Fundamentals, Windows internals, reliability engineering, performance analysis, power efficiency, or system-level diagnostics.
* Experience designing secure and compliant services with solid observability, deployment controls, data-quality practices, live-site response, and operational accountability.
* Experience defining organizational metrics, cohorts, baselines, and measurement strategies using large-scale telemetry, experimentation, statistical analysis, or Azure data platforms.
* Track record of influencing architecture and product strategy, applying automation or AI to engineering workflows, mentoring senior engineers, and collaborating with executive and senior technical stakeholders.

The team works with technologies including:

* C, C++, C#, Python, PowerShell, SQL/KQL, scripting, and automation tools.
* WinDbg, Windows Performance Analyzer, ETW, and diagnostic and trace-processing systems.
* Kusto, Azure services and data platforms, distributed systems, orchestration, storage, deployment, and monitoring systems.
* Power BI, statistics, experimentation, anomaly detection, and large-scale telemetry analysis.
* Machine learning, AI-assisted analysis, and automated diagnostic and remediation workflows.

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Software Engineer III - Linux New
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.


Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.


We are looking for someone who will own the architecture and health of the Linux side of Developer Compute — the fleet of AWS WorkSpaces, WSL, and Linux config that thousands of engineers build on every day. You'll set the standard for how the team ships Ansible changes through peer review, do the deep OS\-internals work that keeps the fleet healthy, and act as the final technical authority when a problem survives first\-line and self\-service troubleshooting. This is a hands\-on senior Unix engineering role: you diagnose from strace and journalctl, design the fix at the platform level, and make sure it's codified so the same problem doesn't recur across the fleet.


**The Role at a Glance**


* Architect and own the Linux compute platform — the design decisions behind AWS WorkSpaces, WSL, and the broader Linux fleet that thousands of engineers build on daily.
* Set the automation standard: define how configuration, patching, and lifecycle management are codified in Ansible and enforced through engineering review, not just author individual changes.
* Act as the final technical authority on hard Unix/identity/infrastructure problems — the ones that survive first\-line and self\-service troubleshooting.
* Drive the platform's technical roadmap: OS/region expansion, deprecation of legacy images, and R\&D into Unix\-ecosystem capabilities the fleet doesn't yet have.


**What You'll Do:**


* Resolve fleet\-wide health issues at the root: Investigate unhealthy/stuck/disconnecting WorkSpaces reported daily by end users — stale desktop\-session state, broken shell config after a distro migration, disk/memory exhaustion, CloudWatch\-reported anomalies — and fix the underlying cause via Ansible rather than a one\-off reboot.
* Own Ansible for the Linux/WorkSpaces fleet: Author and review playbooks and roles covering package management, DNS/nameserver config, credential\-refresh scripts, PAM/Kerberos, and systemd\-based job scheduling; land changes through a peer\-reviewed merge\-request workflow with staged rollout and a rollback plan.
* Troubleshoot auth and identity plumbing: Debug Kerberos/KCM cache issues, kinit failures, GSSAPI/publickey SSH auth errors, and STS regional\-endpoint assumptions across accounts — the kind of problems that show up as "VSCode SSH won't connect" but trace back to credential caches or IAM endpoint config.
* Keep package management and toolchains working: Own issues across modern and traditional Linux package managers and internal package repositories — SSL/cert trust issues, GPG signature failures, repository\-trust enforcement changes — so day\-to\-day package installs keep working across every supported distro and macOS/WSL.
* Support new region and OS rollouts: Help stand up new WorkSpaces regions and new OS bundles (e.g. newer Ubuntu/Rocky Linux releases) — directory setup, bundle config, lifecycle automation, and portal integration — and lead migration paths off end\-of\-life images.
* Build observability, not just fixes: Extend monitoring for Ansible run failures and workspace health so issues surface as alerts before they become a wave of support requests; contribute to diagnostic tooling that lets users self\-service common problems.
* Debug container and dev\-tool issues on the fleet: Resolve container networking\-at\-boot failures, credential\-in\-container breakage, dev container support, and IDE/SSH integration issues that block engineers mid\-task.
* Set the platform standard and mentor: Define how root\-cause fixes get codified into Ansible and documentation rather than repeated as generic advice; raise the technical bar of the wider team and be the reference point for how hard Unix problems get diagnosed and closed out permanently.


 **What You'll Need:**


* Experience: 5–8\+ years in Linux systems engineering, with real ownership of production Linux fleets — not just following documented procedures.
* AWS WorkSpaces / VDI depth: Hands\-on experience operating and troubleshooting AWS WorkSpaces (or equivalent Linux VDI) — directory integration, bundle/image lifecycle, region rollouts, connectivity and performance diagnosis (WSP protocol, CloudWatch metrics).
* Advanced Unix/Linux fundamentals: Comfortable reasoning about systemd, PAM, Kerberos/KCM credential caches, SSH auth mechanisms (publickey, GSSAPI), filesystem/permission issues, and using strace/journalctl/perf to get from symptom to root cause \- not just restarting the service.
* Ansible in production: Strong hands\-on Ansible — playbooks, roles, idempotency, staged rollout — and comfort working through a peer\-reviewed merge\-request workflow with CI as the primary way changes reach the fleet.
* Package ecosystem knowledge: Familiarity with Linux package managers across distros (apt/dnf), Homebrew, and modern declarative package/environment managers (e.g. Nix\-based tooling) — including the cert\-trust, GPG\-signing, and repo\-config issues that come with managing them at fleet scale.
* R\&D mindset: A track record of independently digging into unfamiliar problems (e.g. AWS/Rocky Linux bug backports, kernel\-level networking issues) rather than waiting for someone else to hand you a fix.
* Cloud \& directory services foundation: Solid AWS fundamentals (IAM, STS, VPC networking) and enough Active Directory/Kerberos literacy to debug identity issues that span the two.
* Communication under pressure: Able to work a live escalation with a blocked engineer without guessing — diagnose, explain, and close the loop; comfortable being the person others turn to when first\-line steps don't work.
* Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent hands\-on experience considered.

title: Principle Software Engineer (Java)
description:
**Business Unit:**

Cubic Transportation Systems**Company Details:**
====================


When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  

  

We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.**Job Details:**
================

**Principal Software Engineer — Java**

  

Lead architecture, design, and hands\-on delivery for a security\-critical, **multi\-tenant fintech platform** that issues and manages virtual payment/transit cards across mobile wallets (Apple Wallet, Google Wallet) and EMV/contactless systems — including card tokenization and HSM\-backed cryptography. You'll own technical direction across the full lifecycle and raise the engineering bar for payment\-grade systems.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Own architecture and design for scalability, security, and performance across a **schema\-per\-tenant** multi\-tenant platform.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership end to end, in a domain where financial and cryptographic correctness is paramount.
* Build and evolve core subsystems using **Java 17/21, Java EE, Spring / Spring Boot**: virtual card lifecycle, **payment tokenization (e.g., Mastercard MDES)**, key management, and wallet provisioning (**APNs**, Google Wallet).
* Ensure reliable external integrations — card networks, key\-management/HSM services, device notification, and downstream **REST/SOAP** endpoints — with retries, timeouts, and idempotency.
* Design messaging/integration with **Kafka and Apache Camel**; caching with **Redis**.
* Own data design and performance across **PostgreSQL and Oracle** (Liquibase migrations, Hibernate/JPA tuning).
* Produce design docs, architecture diagrams, and threat models; mentor engineers on coding and secure\-coding standards.
* Drive **CI/CD** with Jenkins (pipeline\-as\-code), **Gradle**, and **Docker**.
 **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **10\+ years** in software development with strong Java; **3\+ years** in technical leadership/architecture.
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Deep hands\-on **Java EE, Spring Boot, and Spring** on long\-lived, service\-oriented backends.
* Solid **security \& cryptography**: TLS/PKI, key management, HSMs, encryption/signing, secure handling of sensitive data.
* **PostgreSQL and Oracle** (SQL Server a plus) with **Hibernate/JPA**; multi\-tenant data experience strongly preferred.
* **REST and SOAP** integration design with resilient outbound\-call patterns.
* Containerization (**Docker, Kubernetes**) and service\-oriented/microservices architecture.
* Strong grasp of concurrency, transactions, and distributed\-system failure modes.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and leadership.
 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Fintech/payments**: EMV, contactless, card tokenization (MDES or equivalent), PCI\-aware development.
* Mobile wallet provisioning: **Apple Wallet (APNs), Google Wallet**, or similar device\-tokenization flows.
* Production **Kafka, Camel, Redis**; **Gradle** builds; observability with **Micrometer/Prometheus** and **Log4j2**.
* Front\-end exposure (Angular, Node.js); IaC (**Terraform, Ansible**) / ARM / CloudFormation.

Lead software architecture and modernization


Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well\-structured, domain\-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.


Modernize application foundations


Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.


Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability


Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

Move business logic out of database\-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event\-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.


Raise the bar for code quality and testing


Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.


Create reusable engineering patterns


Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.


Turn technical strategy into cross\-team execution


Translate architectural risk into clear code\-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.


What This Is Not


This is not a people\-management or architecture\-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.


This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long\-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

Deep backend and distributed\-systems engineering

Service transformation and architecture judgment


You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.


Production reliability and performance expertise


You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.


Software design and refactoring depth


You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.


Data and integration depth


You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.

title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.  

  

You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.  

  

This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.  

  

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high\-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.  

  

If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.

* Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
* Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline

  

About the team  

We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month\-end close — one of the most complex and high\-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub\-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions — ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration — that keep Amazon's financial engine running.  

  

What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state — and this role helps lead the way there.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

title: Sr BI Developer
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced **Senior BI Developer** with strong hands\-on expertise in **Power BI and Databricks** to design, develop, and optimize enterprise\-grade business intelligence solutions. The candidate will be responsible for developing scalable **Power BI semantic models, complex DAX solutions, secure reporting frameworks, and high\-performance dashboards** for multiple business audiences.
The ideal candidate should have strong experience working with **Power BI on Databricks**, including Databricks SQL Warehouse connectivity and making appropriate architectural decisions between **DirectQuery and Import** modes. The role requires the ability to design reporting solutions that support diverse audiences ranging from operational users to senior executives. **Key Responsibilities****Power BI Development \& Reporting*** + Design, develop, and maintain **enterprise\-grade Power BI reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions**.
	+ Develop interactive reports and visualizations tailored to different business and stakeholder requirements.
	+ Translate business requirements into effective BI solutions and intuitive data visualizations.
	+ Implement reusable reporting components and standards to ensure consistency across Power BI solutions.
	+ Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

**Semantic Modelling*** + Design and develop robust **Power BI semantic models** to support enterprise reporting and analytics.
	+ Develop appropriate relationships, hierarchies, calculated columns, and measures within semantic models.
	+ Implement dimensional modelling principles and optimize models for usability and performance.
	+ Design models that can support multiple reports and diverse business audiences.
	+ Ensure semantic models provide consistent definitions and trusted business metrics across reporting solutions.

**DAX Development*** + Develop complex **DAX measures and calculations** for business reporting and analytical requirements.
	+ Optimize DAX expressions and data models to improve report performance.
	+ Develop time\-intelligence calculations, KPIs, aggregations, and other advanced analytical measures.
	+ Troubleshoot and optimize inefficient DAX calculations and model structures.

**Power BI Security*** + Implement **Row\-Level Security (RLS)** to ensure users have appropriate access to business data.
	+ Design and maintain role\-based access models across Power BI datasets and reports.
	+ Work with security and business stakeholders to define appropriate data\-access requirements.
	+ Troubleshoot security and data\-access issues within Power BI environments.

**Power BI \& Databricks Integration*** + Develop Power BI solutions using **Databricks SQL Warehouse** as a data source.
	+ Configure and optimize connectivity between Power BI and Databricks.
	+ Evaluate and implement appropriate connectivity approaches based on reporting requirements.
	+ Demonstrate a strong understanding of the trade\-offs between **DirectQuery and Import modes**, including performance, data freshness, scalability, and user experience.
	+ Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure Databricks data structures are optimized for downstream BI consumption.
	+ Identify opportunities to improve query performance and reporting efficiency across the Power BI and Databricks architecture.

**Performance Optimization*** + Monitor and optimize Power BI report, semantic model, DAX, and query performance.
	+ Identify performance bottlenecks across the BI solution and implement appropriate remediation.
	+ Optimize data models, DAX expressions, queries, visualizations, and connectivity configurations.
	+ Use Power BI performance\-analysis capabilities to diagnose and resolve performance issues.
	+ Ensure reports remain responsive and scalable as data volumes and user populations increase.

**Reporting Architecture*** + Design reporting architectures that support **multiple audiences**, including operational users, management, senior leadership, and executives.
	+ Establish standards for report development, semantic modelling, security, performance, and deployment.
	+ Develop scalable BI solutions that can accommodate multiple business units, functions, and reporting requirements.
	+ Collaborate with Data Architects and Data Engineers to define appropriate data structures for BI consumption.
	+ Contribute to enterprise BI architecture, standards, and best practices.

**Stakeholder Collaboration*** + Work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, data engineers, architects, and leadership teams.
	+ Gather and clarify reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
	+ Present dashboards and analytical insights to business stakeholders.
	+ Support troubleshooting and resolution of reporting and data\-related issues.
	Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other BI developers.  
	+

  

**Required Skills \& Experience*** + Strong hands\-on experience as a **Power BI Developer / Senior BI Developer** in enterprise production environments.
	+ Strong expertise in **Power BI semantic modelling**.
	+ Advanced proficiency in **DAX**, including complex measures, calculations, and performance optimization.
	+ Hands\-on experience implementing **Row\-Level Security (RLS)** in Power BI.
	+ Strong experience with **Power BI performance tuning and optimization**.
	+ Hands\-on experience using **Power BI with Databricks**.
	+ Strong understanding of **Databricks SQL Warehouse connectivity** with Power BI.
	+ Strong understanding of **DirectQuery vs. Import** architecture and the ability to make appropriate implementation decisions based on performance, data volume, latency, and reporting requirements.
	+ Experience designing reporting architectures supporting **multiple audiences and business functions**.
	+ Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and analytical data structures.
	+ Experience developing enterprise dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical solutions.
	+ Strong SQL skills for querying and validating underlying data.
	+ Experience troubleshooting data, model, DAX, connectivity, and report\-performance issues.
	+ Strong understanding of Power BI workspace, dataset/semantic model, report, and data\-source concepts.
	+ Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
	Strong communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.  
	+

  

**Strongly Preferred Skills*** + Experience developing **executive and board\-level reporting**.
	+ Experience designing dashboards and reports for **C\-level and senior leadership audiences**.
	+ Hands\-on experience with **Power BI Deployment Pipelines**.
	+ Experience implementing enterprise Power BI release and deployment processes.
	+ Experience using **Unity Catalog as a governed data source for the Power BI semantic layer**.
	+ Experience with large\-scale **multi\-division or multi\-business\-unit Power BI deployments**.
	+ Experience establishing enterprise BI governance and development standards.
	+ Experience with Power BI administration and workspace governance.
	+ Experience with Azure data services and the broader **Azure data ecosystem**.
	+ Experience working with large datasets and high\-concurrency Power BI environments.
	+ Experience implementing BI solutions integrated with enterprise data lakes/lakehouses.

In this role, you will play a critical role in improving and enhancing our Salesforce environment while managing the third party solutions that interact with the CRM. You'll partner with our Salesforce operations team to build onto the mission critical systems that are core to iCIMS' go\-to\-market success. This is an excellent opportunity to drive business efficiency and velocity through automation. If you are a Salesforce development SME with a passion for developing robust and scalable salesforce solutions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you!
About Us:

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end\-to\-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.  

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise\-grade hiring technology, AI\-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.
Responsibilities:
* Modify existing configurations within Salesforce
* Debug complex technical issues and deliver appropriate immediate fixes \& long\-term solutions.
* Lead projects and focus groups with the goal of meeting business needs in alignment with long\-term corporate technology goals.
* Protect Salesforce data according to iCIMS’ data classification policies.
* Design and develop integrations through native APIs and Mulesoft
* Proactively address system errors to provide both immediate resolution to problem as well as devise a proposed long\-term fix for the issue.
* Proactively ensure integrations run as scheduled and planned. \- Participate in testing activities of transaction systems, reporting and integration.
* Participate in testing and validating system fixes and enhancements and assisting with user acceptance testing.
* Assisting with the configuration of existing application.
* Enhancing existing components of current system (new functionality, queries, reports, etc.)
* Implementing third\-party products to work with application.
* Lead and support various ad hoc projects, as needed.


Qualifications:
* At least 5 years of progressive experience working with Salesforce development projects and deep familiarity with Salesforce platform
* Salesforce Platform Developer certification
* Strong knowledge of software development life\-cycles, systems engineering and business process re\-engineering
* Experience with system integrations, preferably involving Salesforce.com and Mulesoft
* Experience with web services and API’s in Salesforce: REST, Tooling, Metadata, SOAP
* Knowledge of data management, including data capture, warehousing, segmentation, mining, storing, cleaning and security
* Ability to see and understand overall technical architecture to ensure system integrity through a high volume of iterative changes
* High\-level knowledge of project management, software development cadence, and a high\-level of demonstrated organizational skills
* Proficient with Apex, Lightning Components, All Salesforce Automation builder tools (Flow, Process Builder), and JavaScript
* Hands\-on experience on Visual Studio Code IDE, GitHub, Jira \- Experience with Agile methodology project organization (Scrum)

iCIMS is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. title: Engineering tech lead/ Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

  

In this role, you will

* Design and engineer software with the customer/user experience as a key objective.
* Actively contributes to Technology Engineering Practice by sharing Subject Matter Expertise from their area of specialism, best practice and learnings.
* Drives adherence to all standards and policies within their area of Technology Engineering
* Delivery and support of data related infrastructure and architecture to optimise data storage and consumption across the bank, including addressing functional and non\-functional requirements relevant to data in large applications
* Design and develop applications for internal and external users focussing on the interface and front\-end usability of the application.
* Engineer and implement security measures for the protection of internal and external systems, networks, products and services.
* Establish a digital environment and automate processes to minimize variation and ensure predictable high quality code and data
* Assist in team development while holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging organizational resources to improve capacity for project work; and mentoring and developing team members.
* Promote empowerment of the team, ensure that each team member is fully engaged in the project and making a meaningful contribution, and encourage a sustainable pace with high levels of quality for the team.
* Managing stakeholder communications and helping to implement an effective system of project governance

  

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* Knowledge of Java and Cloud Technologies and related products
* Experience in Java, SpringBoot, Kubernetes \& Docker, MongoDB, SQL, Micro Service Design, Kafka, GCP, React JS,
* Experience on design and implement DevOps Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Pipeline.
* Experience supporting middleware / database design, build and troubleshooting in development and production environments.
* Experience of working with monitoring and alerting tools such as but not limited to AppDynamics, Splunk, Geneos and IBM Tivoli Monitoring.
* Experience in agile and DevOps environment using team collaboration tools such as Jenkins, Github, Confluence and JIRA.
* Working with Ops, Dev and Test Engineers to ensure operational issues (performance, operator intervention, alerting, design defect related issues, etc.) are identified and addressed at all stages of a product or service release / change.
* Provide support in identification and resolution of all incidents associated with the IT service, as directed by leadership of the DevOps team,
* Ensure service resilience, service sustainability and recovery time objectives are met for all the software solutions delivered.
* Keep up to date and have expertise on current tools, technologies and areas like cyber security and regulations pertaining to aspects like data privacy, consent, data residency etc. that are applicable
* Technical leadership of large team of developers and help development of team capabilities. Work with senior business stakeholders
* Experience in AI agents, Agentic AI architectures
* Knowledge on Vector DB, Graph DB, LLM’s, Ontology.
* Having knowledge of GRC domain will be an advantage e.g. designed system which does Risks and Control assessments. Knowledge on Products such as Open Pages, Archer, Metrix streams , Service now IRM will be good to have


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.


www.hsbc.com/careers


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
